meta.name: Baarish 2019
meta.description:
Anuj and Gauravi are two complete strangers, who hail from two completely different backgrounds, both economic and cultural. After his father's death, Anuj quits his studies to take care of his siblings and the family business. Years of hard work pays off, and he manages to build his own business empire. On the other hand, Gauravi grows up in a middle-class family, the one where education holds prime importance. An unexpected marriage arranged by both their families ties them together in a relationship under transactional situations. However, it doesn't take them long to fall in love with each other, when the rains decide to write their destiny.

Ended · First aired 25 Apr 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20 | S2 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: The Miracle!!
videos.overview: Sudden downpour brings two drastically different individuals, Gauravi and Anuj together. Life is about to change for them.

videos.title: Aaj Mausam Bada Beimaan Hai
videos.overview: Gauravi gets into serious trouble when her manager questions her about the missing necklace that she delivered at the fashion show.

videos.title: Destiny!!
videos.overview: Anuj rescues Gauravi when she loses her job. Later, she learns that Anuj is the owner of Mehta Diamonds.

videos.title: Marriage Proposal?
videos.overview: Aniket refuses to tie the knot before Gauravi. Anuj’s mother has a solution to the problem.

videos.title: Perfect Jodi?
videos.overview: Gauravi and Anuj meet to discuss their options. Gauravi concludes that they cannot marry as they have nothing in common.

videos.title: Marriage Ingredients
videos.overview: Rishi insults Gauravi and her family at Mehta Diamonds’ annual Family Day party. Anuj reprimands Rishi for his insolence.

videos.title: Roka
videos.overview: Anuj and Gauravi feel that they have made the right decision. But Rishi is not happy about Anuj’s choice.

videos.title: Sangeet
videos.overview: At the Sangeet ceremony, Gauravi meets the woman Anuj once loved. Rishi swears to make life hell for Gauravi.

videos.title: Dilse Dil Ko Baandhta Hai
videos.overview: Gauravi weds Anuj and Shreya weds Aniket. Anuj and Gauravi spend awkward wedding night in their suite.

videos.title: Woh Teen Mahine
videos.overview: On Gauravi’s insistence, Anuj makes a presentation in English. He gets upset when he fails to impress his clients.

videos.title: Don’t F##K IT Up Anooz!!
videos.overview: Gauravi promises Anuj she will not interfere in his matters. Anuj tells her everything about his relationship with Falguni.

videos.title: Anuj’s Disappearance
videos.overview: Gauravi follows Anuj’s trail and is shocked to learn his secret.

videos.title: Anuj’s Birthday, Gauravi’s Gift!!
videos.overview: Gauravi organizes a birthday party for Anuj. He feels grateful towards Gauravi for making him feel special.

videos.title: Arranged Marriage!!
videos.overview: Anuj meets with an accident on his way to Pune. Shreya leaves for Dubai after an argument with Aniket.

videos.title: Siblings v/s Spouses
videos.overview: Gauravi and Anuj stand divided in the conflict between their siblings. Anuj supports Shreya and Gauravi stands by her brother, Aniket.

videos.title: Pyaar Na Thoda Complicated Hota Hai
videos.overview: Gauravi disappoints Anuj when she tries to contact Shreya. Later, she thinks it is in their best interest if she leaves Anuj.

videos.title: Dark Clouds
videos.overview: Asmi faces wardrobe malfunction as a show stopper. Anuj questions Rishi on his intentions.

videos.title: It's Complicated
videos.overview: Anuj addresses a press conference in English. His mother suffers a heart attack, and Gauravi keeps him in the dark about it.

videos.title: Tum Wahan.. Main Yahan
videos.overview: Anuj and Gauravi meet at their favourite place to discuss the future of their relationship. Mehta’s restaurant catches fire and police come to arrest Anuj.

videos.title: Pyaar Andha Hota Hai
videos.overview: Gauravi takes all the blame to save Anuj. Rishi and Shreya flee the country.

videos.title: Waqt Ne Kiya Kya Haseen Sitam Tum Rahe Na Tum, Hum Rahe Na Hum
videos.overview: Gauravi and Anuj have separated and have petitioned for mutual divorce. They have been granted six months of counselling to resolve their differences.

videos.title: Aap Se Tum Tak Ka Safar
videos.overview: Anuj and Gauravi are restarting their lives after the restaurant fiasco. Rishi and Shreya make a comeback.

videos.title: Yeh Ghar Bahut Haseen Hai
videos.overview: Anuj and Gauravi move into a new home, kickstarting a new chapter of their life. Will Aniket and Shreya be able to brush-off their opposing views?

videos.title: Bin Bole Sab Jaanta Hai… Dil Ko Dil Se Baandhata Hai… Kitne Bholasa Ye Pyaar Hai
videos.overview: Anuj and Gauravi break the news of pregnancy at the family get together. Aniket is blackmailed by Shreya.

videos.title: Ye Kya Ghadi Hai… Hum Ajnabi Hain… Duniya Meri Kyu Mujhse Khafa Hai…
videos.overview: Anuj has fallen into difficulty due to a misplaced consignment. Rishi mocks Gauravi when she approaches him to help Anuj.

videos.title: Chaahe Kitni Dooriyaan Hongi Darmiyaan... Sunn Raha Phir Bhi Dil, Dil Ki Ye Daastaan
videos.overview: Anuj strives to give Gauravi a better life and joins as a partner with Rakesh Desai whereas, Gauravi joins Manit’s firm. Is Rakesh as honest as Anuj thinks?

videos.title: Ye Ishq Ab Le Jo Imtehaan… Dene Chale Hum Beparrwaah…
videos.overview: Anuj plans for Gauravi’s surprise birthday celebration but misses it. Aniket warns Shreya to stay away from Rohit.

videos.title: Ghadi Waqt Dikhati Hai, Waqt Deti Nahi Hai…
videos.overview: Manit’s surprise birthday celebration for Gauravi does not go down well with Anuj. Anuj behaves disrespectfully with Manit at an event.

videos.title: Lamhon Se Likhdi Ek Daastaan.. Khamoshiyon Ki Padhtey Zubaan
videos.overview: Asmi and Rohit plan to get married, but Shreya keeps intruding their relationship. Aniket asks Shreya to stop hassling Rohit and Asmi. Anuj threatens Aniket over Shreya.

videos.title: Dheere Chalne Se Peeche Chhoot Jaate Hain… Tez Chalne Se Yaadein Peeche Chhoot Jaati Hain…
videos.overview: Asmi and Rohit’s wedding day has arrived. There is a clear discomfort between Anuj and Aniket. At the wedding, Shreya attempts suicide.

videos.title: Apna Bhi Ho Jaayega – Divorce!!
videos.overview: Manit’s presence at the wedding triggers Anuj to leave the wedding. Anuj’s insecurity leads Anuj to accuse Gauravi of an affair.

videos.title: Tujhse Ho Roothe Roothe… Tujhme Hi Toote Toote
videos.overview: Aniket visits Anuj, to apologize, he realizes that Gauravi is not home. Gauravi moves back to her parents’ house.

videos.title: Kisi Ek Ki Wajah Se, Do Logon Ko Dukhi Nahi Hona Chahiye
videos.overview: Rohit and Asmi are surprised to know that Shreya has thrown them a party at their getaway. Shreya takes advantage of a drunk Rohit.

videos.title: Tumhari Wajah Bhi Badal Gayi Hai, Hamare Haalat Ki Tarah
videos.overview: Asmi and Rohit patch up, but there are still unresolved differences between Anuj and Gauravi. Manit and Gauravi expose an important truth about Rakesh, Anuj’s partner.

videos.title: Tumhi Uljhe Rahe Hamein Aazmane Mein
videos.overview: Anuj gets arrested in the raid, instead of Rakesh. On Falguni’s advice, Gauravi is slapped with a divorce by Anuj.

videos.title: Mera Kuch Saaman, Tumhare Paas Padha Hai
videos.overview: Gauravi signs the divorce papers, both are advised counselling for six months. Rakesh gets arrested based on a tip provided by Anuj.

videos.title: Ab Bas, Aaramse Iss Divorce Ko Ho Jaane Do
videos.overview: Anuj realizes his mistake and wishes to atone for. He also learns about Shreya’s drug addiction. After a long time, Gauravi expresses her feelings to Anuj.

videos.title: P.A.T.I - Patience Always Till Infinity
videos.overview: Anuj rebuffs to fall prey to Rishi’s maneuver. Gauravi joins a new workplace but is dismayed by the fact that she will be working with Anuj.

videos.title: Do Shaadiyaan Ek Saath Shuru Hui Aur Ek Saath Khatam Bhi
videos.overview: Shreya is left with nothing, as Rishi holds the legal right to everything she owns. Shreya approaches Anuj for help, he devises a plan. Shreya apologizes to Aniket.

videos.title: The End… Prem Kahani Wo Badi Banti Hai Jismein Aanewali Mushkilein Badi Badi Hon
videos.overview: Gauravi questions Anuj based on a piece of news. At Manit’s engagement party, she learns the truth. Do Anuj and Gauravi give their love another chance?
